Basis.description: A Workspace Basis (Liminal): an immutable set of members.

digest.description: `sha256:` over the JCS of the sorted `[path, digest]` pairs.

id.description: Liminal's name for it (`liminal-basis://…`); echoed, never interpreted.

DeclaredLimits.description: Lowered limits a request may declare.

GitObservation.description: What one `git` read of the tree's history answered.

args.description: Its arguments, the repository left out.

error.description: Why it failed, when it did.

stdout_hex.description: Its stdout as lowercase hex, when it succeeded.

Member.description: One member of a basis: a path and its exact bytes, never a path alone.

hex.description: The bytes as lowercase hex, otherwise.

utf8.description: The bytes, when they are UTF-8.

withheld.description:
Held by digest only, deliberately: the member is listed and found,
and a reader that needs its bytes is reported (`host.member-withheld`).
`war host --export` withholds what the standalone build listed and
never read.

Node.description: A record as a Liminal Node (OW-ADR-0031).

jurisdiction.description: Who governs it: its Jurisdiction (`governed_by` in the model).

revision.description: Its revision: a member of the Workspace Basis.

source.description: The basis member that holds it.

Observations.description: Facts the readers observe outside the bytes.

Options.description: What the request asks for beyond the model.

kind.description:
`warrant` (a Warrant's committed views). Kinds the projection
targets of OW-WAR-0148 M6 add are answered through its render seam.

subject.description: A Warrant alias, or `*` for every Warrant.

kind.description:
`part_of`, `parent`, `supersedes`, `roadmap`, `implements`,
`depends_on` or `promoted_to`; from authored relations (OW-WAR-0148
M3), any core kind or a namespaced one (`x.mentions`), which is
carried and drives nothing.

to_revision.description:
The revision of `to` the relation pins (`REQ-pr1@sha256:…`), when it
pins one. A pin that is not `to`'s revision now reads stale.

SignatureObservation.description: What `ssh-keygen -Y verify` answered for one set of bytes.

key.description:
sha256 hex over the length-prefixed allowed signers, principal,
namespace, response, signature and key-list label.

basis.description: The Workspace Basis: every file of the WAR records, by its exact bytes.

nodes.description:
The WAR records as Liminal holds them. Compared with the compiled
records; a difference is reported, never repaired.

observations.description:
Facts observed outside the bytes, taken on the host's trust and never
re-checked here.

relations.description: The WAR relations as Liminal holds them, compared likewise.
